## SECURITIES AND FUTURES COMMISSION

12th Floor, Edinburgh Tower, The Landmark, 15 Queen's Road Central, Hong Kong

## Securities and Futures Commission Investment Products Department

General Circular to SFC-approved Fund Management Companies (GC02/01-225/IP/6107)

Subject:

Money Market Funds - Amendment to the Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds

## Background

1. The Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds ("Code") currently imposes a minimum subscription rule on Hong Kong dollar denominated money market funds. Chapter 8.2(i) of the Code sets out that:

For schemes investing in Hong Kong dollar denominated instruments:-

- (i) the minimum level of subscription by each investor must be HK$50,000; and
- (ii) if an investor's holding in such schemes falls below HK$50,000 (by means of partial redemption), then the management company must require the investor to redeem his units/shares in full.
2. As part of its efforts to facilitate market development, the Commission is pleased to announce that the minimum subscription requirements are removed from the Code with immediate effect.

## Implications for Existing Money Market Funds

3. Authorised Hong Kong dollar denominated money market funds that wish to remove the provisions concerning minimum subscription requirements from the offering documents must do so in accordance with the constitutive documents of the schemes. Notices to holders, together with any proposed amendments to the offering documents, should be submitted for the SFC's prior approval.
